contrasts.line: Daring picks the risky thrill. Determined just refuses to give up.
Fearless feels no fear. Determined may feel like quitting, and keeps going anyway.
Reckless charges in without thinking. Determined keeps carefully trying.
Heroic is brave for someone else. Determined is sticking at your own hard thing.
Determined is grit over time. Daring is choosing the risky leap right now.
Daring may feel nerves but chooses the thrill. Fearless feels no fear.
Daring seeks excitement with care. Reckless skips safety.
Daring is for the thrill. Heroic is for helping someone else.
Determined pushes through the urge to quit. Fearless simply never feels the fear.
Fearless has no fear. Daring may feel fear but still chooses excitement.
Fearless is calm near trouble. Reckless is careless near trouble.
Fearless means fear is absent. Heroic means helping someone else despite trouble.
Determined thinks and keeps trying. Reckless stops thinking entirely.
Reckless is careless. Daring wants excitement but can still use safety.
Reckless may rush into harm carelessly. Fearless stays calm, not careless.
Reckless ignores what may hurt people. Heroic protects people.
Determined is about your own goal. Heroic is risking yourself for someone else.
Heroic is for another person. Daring is for excitement.
Heroic helps someone despite fear. Fearless means fear is missing.
Heroic protects others. Reckless forgets safety.
